query.description: Metrics query the tile runs and how it draws it (`display.type`: line, area, bar, stat, gauge, bargauge, table or heatmap). `dateRange` is the default window; the dashboard date filter overrides it. A config update replaces the whole query.

clauses.description: Builder series. Empty when `language` is `promql` or `sql`, or until a metric is picked.

aggregation.description: Omit to get one line per series (at most 100), without combining them

metricType.description: Series identity includes the OTel type — one name can exist as e.g. both a counter and a gauge — so a clause pins it to avoid blending distinct series.

name.description: Alias a formula refers to (e.g. "a"); must be unique within the query

rangeFunction.description: Applied to each series before `aggregation`, like `rate()` in PromQL

date_from.description:
Start of the date range. Accepts ISO 8601 timestamps (e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z) or relative formats: -7d (7 days ago), -2w (2 weeks ago), -1m (1 month ago),
-1h (1 hour ago), -1mStart (start of last month), -1yStart (start of last year).

date_to.description: End of the date range. Same format as date_from. Omit or null for "now". A calendar day without a time (2024-01-15) is inclusive: it rounds to the last moment of that day in the project timezone, unless explicitDate is set.

daysOfWeek.description: Restrict the query to events occurring on these ISO days of week (1=Monday to 7=Sunday), evaluated in the project timezone. Omit or empty for all days. Only applied by insight queries.

excludeIncompletePeriods.description: Exclude the current, still-collecting period by clipping date_to to the end of the last complete interval (evaluated in the project timezone). No-op when the range contains no complete interval. Only applied by insight queries.

explicitDate.description: Whether the date_from and date_to should be used verbatim. Disables rounding to the start and end of period.

dateRange.description: Defaults to the last 24 hours when omitted; dashboard date filters override it

calculation.description: Recalculate from returned chart marks. An absent calculation uses the fixed value.

scope.description: SQL chart calculations use the primary axis, across all series or separately per series.

legendCalcs.description: Time-series panels only: which reducers the legend table shows. Empty means no legend calcs.

nullMode.description: How a null bucket renders on a time-series chart.

reduce.description: How scalar panels and legend calcs collapse a series to one number.

statSummary.description: `stat` display only: which summary the headline value shows.

color.description: A named color token (e.g. "green", "red"), never raw hex, so light and dark themes both work.

value.description: Lower bound of this band. The lowest step is the base color below every other step.

thresholds.description: Color bands for the scalar panels. Sorted by `value` at read time, so entry order does not matter.

unit.description: UCUM unit string as OTel writes it, e.g. "By", "ms", "%". Defaults from the response unit.

max.description: Pins the top of the axis; unset means automatic. Pinning both ends drops the automatic stretch that keeps an off-scale goal line on-plot.

min.description: Pins the bottom of the axis; unset means automatic. Ignored while `startAtZero` is on.

startAtZero.description: When false the axis floats to the data range instead of starting at zero. Ignored on a logarithmic scale, and on the bar display, where a bar's length encodes magnitude from zero.

display.description: Chart presentation. A node without it renders as a line chart.

formula.description: Arithmetic over clause aliases (e.g. "a / b"); when set, only the formula series are returned

interval.description: Bucket size, one of: second_15, second_30, minute, minute_5, minute_15, minute_30, hour, hour_6, day, week; auto-picked from the range when omitted. Coarsened when the range would need more than 10,000 buckets.

language.description: How the query is written; the builder when unset.

promql.description: PromQL expression, run as a range query. Used when `language` is `promql`.

sql.description: HogQL SELECT over the posthog.metric* tables. Used when `language` is `sql`. It must return a `time` and a `value` column; every other column is a series label.

version.description: version of the node, used for schema migrations
